utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still fuzzy on it, honestly—I only heard bits from you, so do you know what they still need and whether Mara or Rosa has confirmed the weekend yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still waiting on Dane to say what needs fixing first, and I haven’t had a weekend confirmation yet. Rosa did say the setup is in the community room at Maple Court by the front entrance, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—that helps. I won’t line up any pickups or promise anything yet, then; once you or Rosa hear back from Dane and confirm the weekend, can you fill me in on what still needs covering?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, we’ve got a repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed—can you make it, and maybe help spread the word too?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can make it, and I’ll keep spreading the word—repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Vik—that really helps; I’m trying to get as many neighbors there as I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus—I’m probably coming in a little late, but I’m in, and I’ll send the day and time around tonight once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Dane—I’ll bring the toolbox and spare drill, and I’ll text you the list tonight so we can compare and avoid doubling up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, Gus—send it over, and once I hear back tonight I’ll match it up and let everybody know what still needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks—please bring the toolbox and spare screws, and text me once you’re on the way so I can count you in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I can do that. I’ll bring the toolbox and whatever spare screws I can round up, and I’ll text you when I’m heading over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks—just send that text before you leave, and we’re set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, if Rosa says it’s confirmed at Maple Court this weekend, can you just confirm the time today so we know whether to start lining up pickups?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check, but I want to verify the sign-up sheet and the pickup times first before I confirm anything today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, please do—can you confirm the time today once you’ve checked the sign-up sheet so we know whether pickups are actually a go?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo — if you still need coverage for the repair drive, I can take a shift outside 7:30–8:30 and 2:30–3:30.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps a lot, Faye—I'll note you down for both outside shifts, and once Gus sends his toolbox list tonight I’ll update the rest of the coverage and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Cleo—I’ll plan on those outside shifts and keep an eye out for your update tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Opal, I need the confirmed location straight and a clear update on those tarps and gloves—who’s tracking them down, and when will you know?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s set up in the community room at Maple Court, right by the front entrance. I’m still tracking down who has the tarps and gloves, and I’ll update you as soon as I get a firm answer tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—keep confirming the tarps and gloves tonight, and tell me exactly who has them and when they’ll be there as soon as you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad it’s set for Sunday at the community center, but I still want Gus’s tool list and pickup timing before we start asking people to bring things twice.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, same here—I’m waiting on Gus’s tool list and pickup timing before I lock the last houses and send people to Maple.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly—I’d rather hold the last asks until Gus texts tonight, so we can point everyone to Sunday at the community center without duplicating tools or confusing pickup timing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for the repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed—just tell me what still needs fixing, and I’ll lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam—I’m still out on errands, but that Saturday 10 to 2 slot at the Maple Street community garden shed is a huge help. Please keep me posted on what still needs fixing and how the repair drive’s coming along tonight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Ira—I’ll check in tonight with what still needs fixing and how things are shaping up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: If it’s mostly the little fixes Eli mentioned, I can probably help with one or two on Saturday once there’s a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That helps, Rey. Once Quinn confirms the time, I’ll finish the list and check the shed first, then I’ll hand you a clear rundown so you can match the Saturday jobs sensibly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—once you’ve got the list sorted, just show me the simple jobs and I’ll see what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, last I heard we were short on tarps and maybe work gloves too, but I honestly lost track of the nails.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, tarps are still the main gap, and gloves too if anyone’s got extras. I’m trying to pin down the rest before tonight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—tarps for sure then, and gloves if folks can spare them. Cleo probably has the cleanest count by now, since I keep missing updates.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, people are definitely keen to help, but I’d stick with what you confirmed: Sunday at the community center, and we’re still waiting on Gus’s tool list before saying anything more firm.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That matches what I have too, Tess—Sunday at the community center is the confirmed plan, and I’ll hold off on any extra details until Gus sends the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds sensible, Rosa—once Gus sends that list, I can help pass along what’s needed without getting wires crossed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Vik, I’m still waiting on final counts, so if you know what we’re short on for the repair drive, send it over and I’ll update the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’m still asking around and pulling people together, so I’ll send over what we’re short on for the repair drive tonight as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik—that helps. As soon as you’ve got the shortages, send them over and I’ll update the list right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a little fuzzy too, but Cleo seems to be the one with the real list, so I’d check with her before we repeat anything. If I hear a firmer update, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps—I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces second-hand, so I’ll check with Cleo or Mara before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’s probably safest—Cleo’s been keeping the actual list, and I’d hate to send you off with yesterday’s version by accident.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Leo, just skim me the sign-up count and tell me if the tools and pickup times are locked yet, and I’ll match it against the house list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still confirming the final sign-up count, and tools are covered; pickup times aren’t locked yet. I’ll send you the count and timing as soon as I get the last confirmations.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—send me the count when you have it, and flag me once pickup times are locked so I can match the house list fast.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for the repair drive—what still needs fixing, and do we have a clear list yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m finishing that list now, and I’ll check the shed against it so we know exactly what’s still missing. Once that’s clear, we can place Faye neatly around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect—once you’ve got the list and shed check done, send it over and I’ll take on whatever needs an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Hana—I’m still out on errands, so please keep me posted on how the repair drive’s coming along tonight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do—I’m checking the sign-up sheet first and confirming with Leo whether the tools and pickup times are still open before I update you tonight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Hana—I appreciate you checking on the sign-up sheet and tool pickup while I’m still out on errands. Keep me posted tonight on what Leo says and how the repair drive’s shaping up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive as long as I’m clear of school drop-off and pickup, so I’m available between 8:30 and 2:30 if that works for the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps—can you cover anything specific in that 8:30 to 2:30 window, or are you waiting on Mara’s confirmation like the rest of us?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can cover a shift anytime between 8:30 and 2:30, but I’m still waiting on Mara to slot me in where I’m most useful.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Opal—I’m still set on starting with the busted bikes, and once Cleo confirms supplies we can move to the garden fence after.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Dane—I’ve got the repair drive marked at the community room at Maple Court by the front entrance, and I’ll note that we’re starting with the busted bikes before shifting to the garden fence once Cleo confirms supplies.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Opal—if Cleo gives the nod on supplies, I’ll head in and start on the bikes first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got it covered—I’ll bring the toolbox and spare drill, and I’ll text you the list tonight so we can avoid doubling up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm the repair drive is definitely happening this weekend before we start counting on that list?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’ll confirm that tonight too when I send the tool list, so you’re not planning around guesswork.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, the repair drive’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed—can you come by, and maybe help spread the word to a couple neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I can swing by Saturday and I’ll spread the word to a couple neighbors from different circles so we get a good mix of help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Jules—thanks a ton; the more folks we pull in from different circles, the better the repair drive will be.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Tess, I’m in for the repair drive—I’m checking with Cleo about tarps, gloves, and where we still need volunteers, and if Dane’s still got bikes first, I’ll start there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s lovely to hear, Mara—I’ve been telling folks Saturday 10 to 2 at the Maple Street shed still looks right, and Gus said he can lend extra hands and a spare drill if we’re short.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great news—thanks for spreading the word, Tess. I’ll still check with Cleo on supplies and volunteer gaps, and if Dane’s keeping bikes first, Gus’s drill should come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I can come by the Maple Street community garden shed at ten with my toolbox and some spare screws, if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren—that helps a lot, but the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so please bring your toolbox there instead.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Sunday at the community center; thanks for reminding me. I’ll bring my toolbox there—what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard bits so far, Uli—if it’s mostly small fixes and there’s a clear list, I could probably help with a simple job. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly little things so far—loose hinges, a wobbly shelf, and a lamp that needs rewiring checked. I’m still waiting on one last confirmation, but if you can take a simple job, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds manageable; if you send me the list once it’s confirmed, I can probably take the shelf or the hinges.
